transcript.en: Thorndyke's.
Good morning. Is that Mr Thorndyke?
transcript.zh: 上午好，请问您是Thorndyke先生吗？

transcript.en: Speaking. How can I help?
transcript.zh: 是的，有什么能为您做的？

transcript.en: I've got quite a few things which need painting and fixing in the flat and I wonder whether you'd be able to do the work.
transcript.zh: 我的公寓里有一些东西需要粉刷和维修，我想知道你能干这些活吗？

transcript.en: I'm sure I'd be able to help but let me take down a few details.
transcript.zh: 我相信这些活我都能干，不过我得先了解一下具体信息。

transcript.en: Yes, of course.
Well	firstly how did you hear about us?
transcript.zh: 首先，您是怎么知道我们的？

transcript.en: It was my friend May Hampton ... you did some excellent work for her a couple of years ago. Do you remember?
transcript.zh: 我是通过我的朋友May Hampton知道你们的......您几年前给她家干过活，效果特别棒，您还记得吗？

transcript.en: Oh yes, that was in West Park Flats, lovely lady.
transcript.zh: 哦，对，在West Park Flats，很可爱的一位女士。

transcript.en: Yes, she is.
And what's your name, please?
It's Edith Pargetter.
Edith ... can you spell your surname, please?
transcript.zh: Edith......不好意思，您能拼读一下您的姓氏吗？

transcript.en: It's P-A-R-G-E double T-E-R.
Double T, right.
And do you live in West Park Flats as well?
transcript.zh: 好的。您也住在West Park Flats吗？

transcript.en: No, actually it's East Park，Flat 4.
transcript.zh: 不，实际上我住在East Park，四号楼。

transcript.en: Oh right,	 that's over the road. I seem to remember quite difficult to get to.
transcript.zh: 哦，好的，我好像记得那里是在马路对面，路挺难走的。

transcript.en: Yes. it's at the back of the library.
Right, I know.
And what's your phone number?
875934, but I'm out a great deal in the afternoons and evenings.
transcript.zh: 875934，不过我下午和傍晚经常都在外面。

transcript.en: So would the best time to ring you be in the morning?
transcript.zh: 所以我最好在上午给您打电话对吗？

transcript.en: Yes.
Fine. I've made a note of that.
Can I just ask I'll be in a van and I know parking's rather difficult round your flats.
transcript.zh: 我想问的是，我到时候会开着面包车过去，我知道您家附近不太好停车，

transcript.en: Where would you recommend?
transcript.zh: 您有可以停车的地方推荐吗？

transcript.en: Well	 I always tell people in larger vehicles to park by the postbox on the other side of the road from the entrance.
transcript.zh: 我经常告诉开大型车辆的人把车停在邮箱旁边，就在入口那条路的另一边。

transcript.en: Good, thanks.
And will you be able to give me a full itemised quote?
transcript.zh: 您能不能给我一个完整的明细报价？

transcript.en: Oh yes. I'll list all the jobs separately with individual prices.
transcript.zh: 可以的，我会把所有的活儿分开列出来，然后每个都单独写上价格。

transcript.en: That'd be a great help.
No problem.
Now	 what would you like me to do?
transcript.zh: 那么您都需要我做些什么呢？

transcript.en: Firstly and most urgently is in the kitchen.
transcript.zh: 第一个也是最紧急的一个活是在厨房，

transcript.en: With all the weather damage	 the glass in the door has cracked and I'd need that fixing ...
transcript.zh: 由于一直以来受到天气的破坏，厨房门上的玻璃已经裂了，我想要您把它修......

transcript.en: I presume you mean replacing?
Oh yes.
And as soon as possible ...
What I'll do is come round tomorrow morning and do that immediately.
transcript.zh: 我明天上午过去，马上帮您换掉。

transcript.en: Thank you so much.
The other things aren't so urgent but ...
transcript.zh: 其他的活没有那么紧急，不过......

transcript.en: Now, I'll make a note of everything you want doing.
transcript.zh: 您把需要我干的活都说一遍吧，我把它们统统记下来。

transcript.en: Well, in the kitchen I'd like some painting doing.
All the kitchen walls?
transcript.zh: 厨房里所有的墙都要刷吗？

transcript.en: Just the area over the cooker.
It's very greasy ...
Right ... it does tend to get that way!
transcript.zh: 是的，那个地方总是那样！

transcript.en: Yes!
Well	if you want a proper job done what I'd need to do is strip the old paint and plaster it about a week before I paint it.
transcript.zh: 如果您想要效果好一点的话，我就需要把墙上旧的涂料扒下来，然后在重新粉刷之前抹上灰泥晾一个星期左右。

transcript.en: Of course.
Now, May tells me you also do work in the garden.
transcript.zh: May跟我说，花园里的活您也会干。

transcript.en: That's right.
Well I'd like you to replace a fence.
transcript.zh: 我想要您帮我换一个栅栏。

transcript.en: Just one?
Yes, at the far end.
Fine. Shouldn't be a problem.
And that's the lot.
Fine.
Yeah, as I say I can come round tomorrow morning to look over things with you.
transcript.zh: 就像我之前说的，我明天上午会过去一趟，跟你一起大致看看情况。

transcript.en: That's great, thank you.
So I'll look forward to seeing you tomorrow at .
